units: <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 10:2">Koh. R. to X, 2</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 13:9">Gen. XIII, 9</cite>) (Abraham said,) <he>אפי׳ את מחצף אנא מַשְׂמְאִיל לך</he> even if thou shalt act irreverently (towards me), I shall show thee the left side (that thou art wrong).

<cite ref="Genesis 13:9">Ib.</cite> <he>הוה אמר … אַשְׂמְאִיל ליה וכ׳</he> he said to one of his household, show him the left side, and he showed him a cutting movement in that direction, v. <cite ref="S00764"><he>קְטִיף</he></cite>
